chunks.title: Latitude and OptiPlex support
chunks.decision: Kept the clientâ€™s hardware problem central to diagnosis rather than optimizing the call around duration.
process: Investigate symptoms with the client.
Explain the hardware issue and next steps clearly.
chunks.outcome: Worked within the Gloves Off support model, aiming to resolve the issue on the first call.
chunks.resumeText: Supported Latitude laptops and OptiPlex desktops on Dellâ€™s Gloves Off team, working through hardware diagnosis with clients and explaining the next steps clearly.
qualificationNotes: No numerical first-call resolution rate is established.

chunks.title: Small Business Server swing migrations
chunks.decision: Separated combined service roles as customers outgrew Small Business Server, keeping identity, data and email dependencies visible.
process: Identify the combined Exchange and Active Directory dependencies.
Use a repeatable swing-migration process into separated infrastructure.
Preserve data and email through the transition.
chunks.technicalGuidance: Developed the migration approach alongside practical server and network project work.
chunks.outcome: Developed a reusable migration process; no measured success rate is established.
chunks.resumeText: Developed a repeatable Small Business Server swing-migration process, separating infrastructure roles while accounting for data, email and identity dependencies.
qualificationNotes: No audited preservation guarantee or exact project date is asserted.

chunks.title: Headquarters infrastructure and move
chunks.decision: Designed for an occupied headquarters, connecting cooling and resilient power to networking, AV and security.
process: Work through infrastructure requirements from planning.
Account for physical and operational dependencies during the build.
Carry the technical plan through the move and transition.
chunks.technicalGuidance: Technical design contribution connected the infrastructure plan with the buildingâ€™s practical operation.
chunks.outcome: Took the technical design through the build and a smooth move/transition, as reported by Josh.
chunks.resumeText: Carried headquarters infrastructure design from planning through build and move-in, accounting for networking, AV, security, cooling and resilient power.
qualificationNotes: No budget or quantified reliability claim.
The broader bare-metal blade centre to ESXi work has no established exact date.

chunks.title: Broker policy inquiry
chunks.decision: Treated an inquiry as both a broker workflow and a data contract, preserving the meaning of policy, billing and claims information.
process: Define inquiry mockups and mappings.
Trace broker SOAP/XML requests and diagnose mismatches.
Test returned values and downloadable documents against the broker workflow.
chunks.technicalGuidance: Connected broker-management vendor requests to proprietary backend information.
chunks.outcome: Contributed inquiry workflows with downloadable policy, billing and claims PDFs.
chunks.resumeText: Connected broker inquiry workflows to backend policy, billing and claims information through mockups, field/value mappings, SOAP/XML request diagnosis and integration testing; REST was used in the later backend.
qualificationNotes: Exact completion date is not established.
Do not turn REST experience into unverified JSON standards experience.

chunks.title: Commercial quoting and broker integration
chunks.decision: Made risk information and insurance meaning explicit across broker inputs, backend fields and rule decisions.
process: Map CSIO/ACORD payload fields, data and values to proprietary backend fields.
Specify fields, UI stages and missing risk information with vendor teams.
Implement related rating/underwriting rules and test broker requests.
chunks.technicalGuidance: Directed UI/specification changes; vendor teams performed commercial quoting development.
chunks.outcome: Connected requirements, mappings and hands-on rules implementation across residential, auto, farm and commercial workflows.
chunks.resumeText: Designed and implemented P&C rating and underwriting rules, mapped CSIO/ACORD broker payloads to proprietary backend fields, and directed UI/specification changes so commercial quoting collected the required risk information.
qualificationNotes: Responsibility does not imply a formal Architect job title.
Vendor teams performed commercial quoting development.
AL3 and eDocs familiarity is supported; hands-on JSON standards experience is not claimed.

chunks.title: Auto and residential new-business integration
chunks.decision: Connected the information collected in the interface to rating, underwriting and the next useful action.
process: Identify missing risk inputs.
Implement rating/underwriting validation.
Help define correction, referral or bind messages for the broker portal.
chunks.technicalGuidance: Directed UI/specification changes and helped design the rules-engine-to-portal messaging framework.
chunks.outcome: Implemented rules connected to submission behavior and transaction context.
chunks.resumeText: Implemented rating and underwriting rules and helped design broker-portal messages for correction, referral or binding, with validation that distinguished new business, renewals and endorsements.
qualificationNotes: No universal automation rate or project-volume claim.

chunks.title: Renewal eligibility and exception routing
chunks.decision: Automated eligible standard renewals while preserving a deliberate human-review path for exceptions.
process: Define renewal-specific eligibility.
Implement rating/underwriting classification for each business context.
Refer exceptions for human review.
chunks.technicalGuidance: Personally designed the renewal framework and implemented the rules.
chunks.outcome: User-reported automation outcomes exist in the case study; numeric claims are deliberately omitted from this reusable chunk.
chunks.resumeText: Designed the renewal eligibility framework and implemented rating and underwriting rules that classified standard policies for automatic renewal while referring exceptions for human review.
qualificationNotes: No independently audited automation result is inferred.

chunks.title: Authenticated document upload and support tooling
chunks.decision: Replaced ad-hoc email delivery with authenticated submission into the correct backend policy record, with operational visibility.
process: Build the C#/.NET portal and authenticated workflow.
Use proprietary REST APIs to place documents in policy records.
Add logging and build internal log-search tooling for recurring issues.
chunks.technicalGuidance: Connected privacy goals to workflow design and support diagnosis.
chunks.outcome: Application became a production business tool; internal support tooling helped investigate recurring upload/download issues.
chunks.resumeText: Built a C#/.NET portal using REST APIs for authenticated submission into policy records, with operational logging and internal log-search tooling to investigate recurring integration issues.
qualificationNotes: No audited security certification, encryption mechanism or authentication protocol is asserted.

chunks.title: Provider data for claims adjudication
chunks.decision: Compared source information and existing interfaces with the new adjudication systemâ€™s actual requirements.
process: Establish provider-integration adjudication requirements.
Analyze source/consumer gaps.
Contribute integration mappings with architects and delivery teams.
chunks.technicalGuidance: Worked alongside architects and delivery teams on requirements, gaps and mappings.
chunks.outcome: Confirmed analysis and mapping contribution; separate implementation/go-live results are not established.
chunks.resumeText: Defined provider-integration adjudication requirements, analyzed source and consumer gaps, and contributed mappings alongside architects and delivery teams.
qualificationNotes: No additional registry-synchronization implementation or go-live claim.

chunks.title: Takeover-history validation and XML loading
chunks.decision: Turned inconsistent incoming history into an explicit, reusable validation and load-preparation process.
process: Ingest and map spreadsheets or data derived from PDFs using an Excel template.
Validate types and data, then transform to the receiving XML schema.
Prepare manageable batch-load files and reconcile returned errors.
chunks.technicalGuidance: Built tooling adopted by the team for repeatable history preparation and loading.
chunks.outcome: Production tooling adopted by the team.
chunks.resumeText: Built production Excel tooling, adopted by the team, to map inconsistent takeover history, validate types and data, export schema-matching XML and prepare batch loads with error reconciliation.
qualificationNotes: Macro language and public platform spelling remain unconfirmed.
No private schema or claim records are included.

chunks.title: Claims reporting continuity mapping
chunks.decision: Recognized the flat-file format from AL3/broker-download experience and followed the actual consumer before choosing a reporting tool.
process: Question the requested reporting format.
Trace the daily COBOL/Interblue flat-file feed into the clientâ€™s Cognos workflow.
Explore cross-team ownership and resourcing.
Analyze the specification and design mappings from new adjudication data to the existing format.
chunks.technicalGuidance: Raised the gap and sought ownership beyond adjudication; continued because other teams lacked capacity and Josh understood the gap.
chunks.outcome: Completed analysis and continuity-mapping design. Bridge implementation/go-live remains unconfirmed; modernization remains proposed.
chunks.resumeText: Recognized an ETL dependency behind a reporting request, traced the daily feed into Cognos, and completed continuity-mapping design from new adjudication data while working through cross-team ownership and resourcing.
qualificationNotes: Completed analysis/design only; bridge go-live unconfirmed.
Power BI or an alternative exchange remains proposed.
PDF/Excel was a counterfactual risk, not an actual wrong delivery.
No formal authority over other teams is implied.

chunks.title: Claims SQL and financial reconciliation
chunks.decision: Kept report logic and reconciliation central while the broader extract/modernization decision remained open.
process: Hand-write claims reporting SQL.
Understand and write financial report logic.
Reconcile and balance claims against the financial view.
chunks.technicalGuidance: Hands-on query and report analysis rather than requirements-only contribution.
chunks.outcome: Completed query/reporting and balancing work; broader exchange decision remained open.
chunks.resumeText: Hand-wrote SQL for claims reporting, developed financial report logic, and reconciled and balanced claims against the financial reporting view.
qualificationNotes: No financial volumes, private queries or database schemas are published.

chunks.title: NEXUS
chunks.decision: Separated plans from review/execution and made context, model choices and outcomes inspectable.
process: Compile scoped retrieval context with project decisions, graph relationships and source receipts.
Use constraint-aware model routing.
Recover distributed Node execution through durable commands and permissions.
Evaluate with deterministic and semantic checks and integration/deployment receipts.
chunks.technicalGuidance: Independent system design and implementation, distinct from employer architecture.
chunks.outcome: Implemented mechanisms in an actively developing product; broader vision is still evolving.
chunks.resumeText: Implemented scoped context compilation, explainable model routing, review/execution separation and recoverable distributed Node execution in NEXUS, using a headless TypeScript core, React/Vite, PostgreSQL/Redis, OpenAPI and WebSockets.
qualificationNotes: Independent project, not employer experience.
Pub/sub architecture is not established by this approved public snapshot.
Do not imply every product vision feature shipped.

chunks.title: LOWKEY
chunks.decision: Connected local speech decoding to native Windows input and an Android keyboard.
process: Capture audio with AudioWorklet and process phrases in a dedicated Rust worker with Silero detection.
Run cached sherpa-onnx/Parakeet models locally.
Connect the result to native input and a Kotlin Android IME; support optional local correction/dictionaries and fallback.
chunks.outcome: Implemented local decoding workflows; no trustworthy numerical speed benchmark exists.
chunks.resumeText: Built local speech-to-input workflows in LOWKEY using React/TypeScript, Rust/Tauri 2 and sherpa-onnx/Parakeet, with AudioWorklet capture, phrase detection and a Kotlin Android keyboard.
qualificationNotes: Independent project, not employer experience.
No universal device support, NPU, speed or absolute-security claim.
Local decoding/source review is not a network audit.
Archived at Josh’s explicit request; excluded from current resume selections.
